category_rule: Categories are charge groupings only; none encodes a protected characteristic or a proxy for one.
caveats: Coverage is UNEVEN and must not be compared across years: 2021=1267, 2022=773, 2023=241, 2024=712, 2025=2863 records. A low year reflects missing reports, not fewer arrests.

The source log is not comprehensive. Verbatim from Cap City News: it omits juvenile offenders, suspects recommended for charges of a sexual nature, and anyone who bonded or bailed out before the information was released. Those exclusions are systematic, not random.
Arrest is not a finding of guilt. Every entry is a recommended charge at booking. This dataset publishes NO outcomes, because it contains none.
Names and exact ages are withheld from this tier by owner policy. Age is withheld because it is a quasi-identifier: age plus charge plus week in a small county can single a person out.
No demographic field is derived, inferred, or published. Do not re-identify: joining these records against other public sources to recover names is out of scope of any access grant.
Rows are arrest EVENTS, not people. One person can appear many times; 160 name+charge pairs recur across different reports.
policy: Arrest records published WITHOUT names and WITHOUT exact ages. Names are released only on request or by paid access code, for public-safety and non-discriminatory research only.
